title: Barbara NDE 3059
content: I had fallen and broken my hip. I was in surgery to have it repaired. During the surgery, I went into respiratory failure. I remember being in a darkness without boundaries and I was not in a body. It was as if the essence or spirit of me was there. I was floating as if in water but there was no water, just a darkness. I was calm, peaceful, and warm and it felt as though I should be there. I don't know how I knew but I was waiting. I did not questions this, I just knew I was there and it was okay. There was no sound, no feeling, and no pain. And it was completely good. But I was unable to advance to the next part of the experience. Then I was in the intensive care unit and back in my body, but still floating. As if my body was a shell and I was disconnected from it. I was aware of everything around me, doctors and nurses coming and going but outwardly, I was still unconscious. I could hear all the sounds and I could think. I was aware of everything, understood everything, and was completely calm and clear in my mind. It was almost matter-of-fact. I was aware of the respiratory equipment breathing for me, my hands were restrained, and I knew when the doctors were drawing blood from me. I felt no pain, no emotion. This state came and went as I went deeper into darkness for two days. Then I came back, reattached to my body, and woke up. They removed me from the respirator after allowing me to breathe on my own for a while. I remember waking up for this. After they took me off the respirator, I did not have any more experiences.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Floating as if in water, but there was no water—just darkness.

environment.environment_other_detail: Darkness without boundaries; no sound; calm, peaceful, warm; felt like she should be there; unable to advance to the next part.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: State 'came and went' and she went deeper into darkness for two days, then 'came back, reattached to my body, and woke up.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Hip repair surgery after a fall; during surgery she went into respiratory failure.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Prolonged ICU period with awareness while outwardly unconscious; repeated drifting into darkness over two days; 'unable to advance to the next part of the experience.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Darkness/void and OBE-like awareness alternated over two days; no tunnel/light/life review/boundary described.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: The state 'came and went' as she went deeper into darkness for two days, then returned/reattached.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She reports being back in ICU 'and back in my body, but still floating' and disconnected, with awareness of staff and procedures while outwardly unconscious; the experience 'came and went' over two days; she was 'unable to advance to the next part of the experience.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I remember being in a darkness without boundaries and I was not in a body.” / “It was as if the essence or spirit of me was there.” / “I was calm, peaceful, and warm and it felt as though I should be there.” / “Then I was in the intensive care unit and back in my body, but still floating. As if my body was a shell and I was disconnected from it.”
